$comment: Data-driven compatibility matrix. Resolver never infers a NAR from a similar filename. Artifact names follow the OpenText NiFi Ingest documented pattern (idol-nifi-*-nar-<version>.nar) plus the nifi2 qualifier required for NiFi 2.x. Proprietary .nar binaries are not bundled; drop them into the matching version directory.

profiles.source: OpenText IDOL NiFi Ingest 26.2 zip / nifi-ver2-full:26.2 image
installRequirements: Wait for NiFi to unpack the API NAR before adding other 26.2 NARs
Do not place 26.3 NARs in the same extensions directory

profiles.source: OpenText IDOL NiFi Ingest 26.3 zip / nifi-ver2-full:26.3 image (NiFi UI 2.9.0 in this project)
installRequirements: Wait for NiFi to unpack the API NAR before adding other 26.3 NARs
Do not place 26.2 NARs in the same extensions directory
